It is expected that the project action should not affect this wildlife significantly. However, incidental to the program, the general health conditions of the residential environment will be upgraded, causing a reduction in the rat population.
6. Physical Character of the Area
a. Existing Character by Subarea
The Randolph Project is composed of three recognizable physical areas each reflecting its own character and environmental composition. Although not clearly divided in all cases, the three sub-categories can generally be divided by the following boundaries. (See Figure No. 3)
Area One extends from Lakeview Avenue to the northern project boundary and from Meadow Street to the eastern project boundary.
Area Two extends from Meadow Street to the western limit and from Lakeview to the northern boundary.
Area Three generally extends from Lakeview Avenue to the southern boundary of Colorado Avenue.
For clarity of presentation each area will be examined as a separate entity then as a composite of the entire project. Environmental concerns will be discussed in the same period.
